'''''Passion Taboo''''' was a romantic [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] that was released during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gar Bettle]], the owner of the holovid shop [[Hedrett Holovid]], wore a holographic pin that advertised the film.
